text:
kyle: Heads-up — we saw a sustained long-tail edge route degradation in us-west-2 around 02:10 UTC. Errors were 502/504s and elevated latency for requests that hit a specific LB path. I dug into logs and it looks like sporadic backend hang combined with retries causing head-of-line queuing.

anita: Ugh. Is this the same pattern we saw last month?

kyle: Not identical. Last month was TLS renegotiation flaps. This feels more like connection saturation + cross-region failover churn when retries are aggressive.

sara: I pulled perf histograms — p50 is fine, p95 and p99 show a clear tail starting ~02:05 and lasting ~20m. Attaching snippet: 
```
route: /api/v1/search - p95: 220ms -> 1.8s, p99: 450ms -> 7.2s
backend pool errors: increased 4x
lb-retries: spike correlates with backend 502 bursts
```

matt: Can we get a quick list of immediate mitigations? Turning down retry count for that route? Throttle concurrent requests to backend?

kyle: Immediate: 1) lower retry attempts for edge route to 1 for us-west-2 (owner: matt, ETA: today EOD) 2) increase LB connection pool limit to backend group-a (owner: anita, ETA: tomorrow) 3) add a temporary rate-limit rule for high-cardinality clients hitting that route (owner: sara, ETA: today)

netops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20345 (link) — added kyle, anita, sara, matt as subscribers.

ops-oncall: Do we have telemetry to detect recurrence automatically? I can add an alert on retry-to-success ratio and long-tail P99.

sara: Yes — I’ll add two alerts: (A) retry ratio > 0.2 sustained for 5m, (B) p99 latency > 2s for the route for 5m. Will post dashboards/graphs. Owner: sara, ETA: 6 hours.

anita: Follow-ups for postmortem: - run a small chaos test to validate backend resilience to connection limits - audit LB client-side retry policy for all routes - propose a smart backoff profile to avoid head-of-line queuing

kyle: Agree. Let's split those: chaos test (owner: anita, ETA: next Tue), retry audit (owner: kyle, ETA: end of week), backoff proposal (owner: matt, ETA: next Wed).

matt: I'll prototype exponential jitter backoff + concurrency cap in the SDK and run load tests.

kyle: Also want to flag this as a recurring-pattern candidate: cross-region failover plus aggressive retrying repeatedly surfaces long-tail. Suggest we add a recurring incident review in the weekly oncall sync to track trends.

ops-oncall: I'll add a recurring agenda item. Can someone drop a short blameless writeup once owners finish their tasks so we can include it in the next oncall review?

sara: Will do. I'll add links to dashboards and the alert configs to the ticket when done.

anita: +1. Meeting to sync owners tomorrow 11:00 UTC?

kyle: Works for me. I'll pull logs and a sample trace to the ticket before the meeting. :thumbsup:

matt: Cool. Marking my task in INC-20345.

kyle: Thanks all — follow-ups tracked in INC-20345. Will check back after the 11:00 sync.
